warning: Descriptive paired-panel worksheet, not a causal effect, significance test, competence certificate or evidence of intervention benefit. Up/down/same counts respect ordinal levels; mean changes assume the supplied 0–4 scale has meaningful equal intervals. Cross-sectional means use all approved observations at each wave; paired means use only the same people with both waves. Their gap can reflect panel composition and selection, not an identified bias correction. Holds and missing waves can be informative. No values are imputed; duplicate approved cells block application. Competency means are not pooled into an overall score.
